referenceRole: style reference only; inspected with view_image and not supplied as an image-generation input
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: small transparent character illustration for the dexterity ability card in a fantasy RPG game UI
Primary request: Create one original image that communicates dexterity as precision, critical hits, and defense: a youthful chestnut-brown-haired cloaked swordsman makes a light, nimble sidestep while parrying a single incoming arrow with his sword. Show a clear small impact glint at the exact blade-arrow contact and a few elegant teal-green speed arcs that reinforce the movement.
Scene/backdrop: no environment; isolated figure and action marks on a fully transparent background.
Subject: one original youthful adventurer with warm brown hair, a teal-green cloak and simple parchment-toned accents; one sword and one arrow only. Show the complete character and the complete sword, with the arrow visibly deflected.
Style/medium: polished hand-drawn storybook fantasy RPG UI illustration, warm expressive outlines, gentle painted texture, charming compact proportions, cohesive warm-brown and teal palette. High-level style cue from the viewed project portrait: friendly youthful character, chestnut hair, dark teal clothing, warm colors; do not reproduce that portrait.
Composition/framing: square composition, centered compact full figure with generous transparent padding; clear readable silhouette, action concentrated around the sword and upper body; use large simple shapes and restrained detail so it remains legible at small card size.
Lighting/mood: lively, confident, nimble, warm and adventurous.
Color palette: chestnut brown, deep teal and soft turquoise, muted parchment beige, a small warm golden-white impact sparkle.
Materials/textures: soft hand-painted shading and warm clean linework; subtle cloth folds only.
Text (verbatim): none.
Constraints: original character and scene; isolated on true transparent background; complete character, cloak, sword, and arrow remain inside the canvas; no essential feature cropped; no excessive micro-detail.
Avoid: any background or ground, extra characters, extra arrows or weapons, blood, violence beyond a harmless arrow parry, text, numbers, letters, symbols, labels, UI panels, card frames, badges, logos, watermarks, checkerboard transparency preview, pixel-art rendering.
